name: application-xp-progress-bar
title: XP Progress Bar
description: Level badge paired with an XP progress bar toward the next level, distinct from application-progress-bars since it carries level/XP-specific semantics rather than a generic percentage.
useWhen: Showing a user's level and progress toward the next level in a gamified product.
Celebrating a level-up moment with the new level and the overflow XP carried into the next bar.
You want level-specific framing (a level badge, 'XP to next level' copy) rather than a generic progress bar.
avoidWhen: The progress isn't level-based — use application-progress-bars for a generic percentage instead.
No real leveling system exists in the product — fabricating XP numbers would mislead users.
The metric is a countdown or quota rather than cumulative growth — use application-usage-meter-card instead.
responsiveBehavior: The card has a fixed max width; the level badge and XP text stay on one row at any width the card supports, wrapping only the surrounding page layout.
accessibility: The bar carries role='progressbar' with aria-valuenow/min/max reflecting the real XP values, not just a visual width.
The current and next level are stated in real text (e.g. 'Level 12', 'XP to next level'), not conveyed by the bar alone.
The level-up state pairs a badge, an icon, and text together, not color alone, to signal the celebratory moment.

variants.title: Level progress
variants.description: Level badge with an XP bar toward the next level and a remaining-XP caption.
accessibility: aria-valuenow/min/max on the progressbar reflect the real current and target XP values.

variants.title: Level progress (Dark)
variants.description: Level-progress XP bar adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Bar fill and badge contrast must meet WCAG AA on dark backgrounds.

variants.title: Level-up celebration
variants.description: Level-up state showing the new level badge, a celebratory icon, and the overflow XP carried into the next level's bar.
accessibility: The 'Level up!' message is real text, not conveyed by the star icon or amber tint alone.

variants.title: Level-up celebration (Dark)
variants.description: Level-up celebration state adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Amber tint and text contrast must meet WCAG AA on dark backgrounds.
